senses.gloss: (b. h.) to cut, decide, determine, limit, bound.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:1:7">Y. Maasr. IV, 51ᵇ</cite> top <he>ק׳ להיסב וכ׳</he> if he had determined to recline for a meal, but did not do so. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:4:3">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חוגג וקוצב</he>, read: <he>וקוֹצֵר</he>.]—Part. pass. <he>קָצוּב</he>; f. <he>קְצוּבָה</he>; pl. <he>קְצוּבִים</he>, <he>קְצוּבִין</he>; <he>קְצוּבוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:10">Tosef. Ter. I, 10</cite> <he>דבר הק׳ מן התורה</he> a thing (duty) the scope of which is clearly defined in the Torah, v. <cite ref="S01786"><he>קִצְבָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 50b:16">Gitt. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>לפי שאין ק׳</he> because they (the alimonies of a widow and of orphaned daughters) are not definite (vary according to social position).

<cite ref="Beitzah 16a:1">Bets. 16ᵃ</cite> top <he>כל … ק׳ וכ׳</he> the means of support are definitely assigned to man from the beginning of the year, except the expenses for the Sabbaths … and for education &c. Cant. R. to IV, 2 (ref. to <he>קצובות</he>, ib.) <he>מלין ק׳</he> definitely regulated things (laws); ib. 4 (some ed. <he>קְצִי׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:4">Y. Ber. V, beg. 8ᵈ</cite> <he>הלכות ק׳</he> decided (settled) questions of law; (Bab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 1:5">Bets. I, 5</cite> <he>לקַצֵּב עליו בשר</he> to carve meat on it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 1:11">Tosef. ib. I, 11</cite> <he>אם קי׳ על העלי</he> if he used the pestle to carve meat on it. Y. Macc. II, beg. 31ᶜ <he>טבח שהוא מְקַצֵּב וכ׳</he> a butcher that chops meat and kills a man (by a slip of the hatchet &c.); a. e.
